title: Achala Compass — Responsible AI & Governance Suite
seo_title: Achala Compass — Responsible AI & Governance Suite | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Achala Compass, our Responsible AI & Governance Suite, gives model-risk and compliance teams validation, monitoring and audit evidence for AI systems.

blocks.x: AI your model-risk committee approves and your regulator can inspect. Achala Compass is the governance suite for the rest of the platform suite, validation, monitoring and evidence in one place.

Achala Compass is our Responsible AI & Governance Suite. It inventories your models, runs validation and fairness testing, monitors drift and performance in production, and files the documentation each review asks for. Governance stops being a slide and becomes a system.
Named modules, each with a clear job:

items: Every model, version, owner and intended use, in one register
Fairness, robustness and performance tests with sign-offs
Drift, bias and performance tracked against thresholds
Review documentation generated from the register, not rebuilt each time

blocks.title: Achala Compass — module topology
blocks.note: Modules are the platform's named components; trust lane is what the audit reads.

blocks.x: Built for review by the strictest reviewer:

items: EU AI Act readiness, model-risk guidelines, ISO/IEC 42001 alignment
Fairness metrics computed and archived per release
Sign-offs recorded with reviewer, scope and date
Production issues traced back to model versions

blocks.x: Achala Compass runs in banking model-risk functions, insurance actuarial review, healthcare AI governance and public-sector AI programs.
Reads from your ML platforms and registries through standard interfaces; monitors any model that serves predictions, whatever trained it.
Bring one model portfolio to a briefing. We will show the register, the validation workflow and the evidence pack it produces.
